headline: Tesla to Buy Power From KKR-Backed Arizona Solar, Battery Plant
summary: (Bloomberg) -- Tesla Inc. struck a long-term deal to buy electricity from a KKR & Co.-backed solar and battery project in Arizona, developer ContourGlobal said.
